BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to participation in extracurricular activities bystudents with physical or mental disabilities; adding a new section tochapter 28A.600 RCW; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the federalindividual with disabilities education act and Washington state lawprovide that education programs are to be provided for students withdisabilities until the student is twentyone, but when the twentyfirstbirthday occurs during the school year, the education program may becontinued until the end of that school year. The legislature furtherfinds that students with disabilities can benefit from being involvedin extracurricular teams or activities at the school they attend. Thelegislature intends to permit a waiver that allows a physically ormentally disabled student to participate in extracurricular high schoolactivities for the duration of their enrollment in high school.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.600RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Washington interscholastic activities association shall provide p. 1 SB 5172a waiver that allows a student with a physical or mental disability, orboth, to participate in extracurricular high school activities for theduration of his or her enrollment in high school.
This act shall be known and cited as the Ikeact.
